{"id":1941922392,"question_id":4247,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"4 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1772971917,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1941922392/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum Capacity Box","memory":"24 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int minimumIndex(vector<int>& capacity, int itemSize) {\n        vector<pair<int,int>>vp;\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<capacity.size() ; i++)\n        {\n            vp.push_back({capacity[i] , i});\n        }\n        sort(begin(vp) , end(vp));\n\n        for(auto it : vp)\n        {\n            if(it.first >= itemSize) return it.second;\n        }\n        return -1;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-capacity-box","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1808}
